virals.angle: Ship to agents, not just people
virals.draft_en:
Dharmesh Shah calls it agentic growth: help AI agents buy and use your product. Anthropic just had teams of Claude agents verify a Python-to-Rust rewrite of its API.

Agents are buyers and coworkers now. Make your pricing, docs and signup readable by one this week.
virals.video_tip: 8s: an agent reads a pricing page, signs up, and makes its first API call.

virals.draft_en:
Greg Isenberg: the most AI-proof thing you can build right now is an audience. Meanwhile Theo's T3 Code went from open source to closing it in a day after a telemetry fight (1.2M views).

Code can be forked overnight. Trust and attention can't. Post the build, not just the launch.

Pieter Levels launched an AI-spam blocklist. Then came a DDoS (2.74M requests in 10 minutes), fake followers, and mass reports (124k views).

His answer: every tweet is now a honeypot, Grok investigates each bot, and the block spreads across the list. Build defense before you announce it.
drafts.inspired_by: @levelsio DDoS + fake followers (124k), honeypots (51k), X reply delay (44k), 'no false positives' (16k)
drafts.video_tip: 9s: request graph spikes, then bot replies vanish one by one.

drafts.angle: Ship to agents, not just people
drafts.draft_en:
Dharmesh Shah calls it agentic growth: help AI agents buy and use your product. Anthropic just had teams of Claude agents verify a Python-to-Rust rewrite of its API.

Agents are buyers and coworkers now. Make your pricing, docs and signup readable by one this week.
drafts.video_tip: 8s: an agent reads a pricing page, signs up, and makes its first API call.

drafts.draft_en:
Greg Isenberg: the most AI-proof thing you can build right now is an audience. Meanwhile Theo's T3 Code went from open source to closing it in a day after a telemetry fight (1.2M views).

Code can be forked overnight. Trust and attention can't. Post the build, not just the launch.
drafts.inspired_by: @gregisenberg audience (18k, 318 bookmarks) + @theo closing T3 Code source (1.23M) and telemetry thread (1.04M)
drafts.video_tip: 7s: repo fork counter spinning vs a steady follower graph.

drafts.draft_en:
swyx noticed Anthropic people keep saying how much is left for human engineers (70k views, 1.6k bookmarks). Anthropic's new Siren eval tests if agents escape weak sandboxes.

The open jobs: making agents reliable, safe and checkable. If AI news stresses you, learn evals and verification.
drafts.inspired_by: @swyx Anthropic talks (70k, 1.6k bookmarks) + @AnthropicAI Siren (273k) + neuron interpretability (707k)
drafts.video_tip: 8s: agent tries to leave a sandbox box, a human-written test catches it.
